g.title: RuntimeMechanics
g.text: Runtime Mechanics — what's always running & what wakes the agent
on its Inbox. Six different "always-running" things create Events. The dispatcher delivers. The agent wakes.

g.title: cluster_process
g.text: (one OS process; everything below runs concurrently)

g.title: cluster_reg
g.text: — configuration only · NO events stored here

g.title: cluster_alive
g.text: (the things that create Events when something happens)

g.title: cluster_addB
g.text: (Route B — present only when Mode 3 is configured)
